title: Persona Schemas
summary: This module defines data structures for representing persona traits, including prompts, questions, and evaluation rubrics, ensuring consistency and validation for persona-related data.

nodes.label: PersonaTraitArtifact
nodes.title: PersonaTraitArtifact Data Model
nodes.description: A Pydantic model defining the structure for a single persona trait, encapsulating contrast prompts, question lists, and a judge rubric for evaluation.

nodes.label: ContrastPromptPair
nodes.title: ContrastPromptPair
nodes.description: A data structure representing a pair of positive and negative system prompts used for contrasting persona behaviors.

nodes.label: JudgeRubric
nodes.title: JudgeRubric
nodes.description: A data structure defining the criteria and guidelines used by a judge to evaluate persona responses.

groups.label: Data Models
groups.title: Core Data Models
groups.description: Defines the foundational data structures for representing persona-related information within the system.
